clips.title: The story
paras: Render's Valley is a tucked-away encampment held by Blackrock orcs in the southeastern Redridge Mountains. Far less entrenched than the massive fortresses of Stonewatch, it nonetheless poses a persistent threat to nearby travelers and hosts captives taken from surrounding lands.

Tucked among the rocky ridges southeast of Lake Everstill, Render's Valley serves as an auxiliary camp for the Blackrock orcs operating in Redridge. Unlike the heavily fortified keeps and stone towers of the northern cliffs, the valley consists of a modest cluster of war tents, banners, and sentry outposts. Despite being smaller and less armed than the clan's core forces, the warriors here raid local roads, harass travelers, and keep captured prisoners in crude cages under guard.

Beyond the war parties roaming its dirt paths, the valley holds unexpected points of interest for intrepid scouts. Human prisoners have occasionally been sighted within the camp, including a captive servant connected to the Tower of Azora who managed to trade specialist goods right under his captors' noses. Additionally, rugged and unmarked pathways through the high southern bluffs behind the valley allow daring pathfinders to slip across the border into the murky bogs of the Swamp of Sorrows.
